plugin.name: Colophon
plugin.summary: One-click JATS/PMC production: send an accepted submission to a Colophon server and receive the finished, deposit-ready package back as a galley.
plugin.description: Sends the accepted manuscript together with the metadata OJS already holds (author emails, corresponding author, DOI, pages, received and accepted dates) to a Colophon server, where references are resolved and verified, figures become production TIFFs, and the XML is checked against PMC's style rules. The finished package returns automatically over a signed webhook (or by polling) and lands as a JATS galley with dependent files. Pairing is zero-copy: press Connect, confirm in the browser, and the plugin picks up its credentials — no keys pasted by hand.

release.description: First public release: one-call send with JATS front enrichment, device-flow pairing, signed webhook delivery, JATS galley with dependent files.
